title: Can you pass this driving mirror quiz?
hook: Most drivers fail this mirror test.

script.narration: Most drivers fail this mirror test. If you can see the side of your own car in your side mirrors while driving normally, are your mirrors set correctly?
Take a second to think. Is it yes, or is it no?

The answer is no! You should barely see your car's edge. This eliminates blind spots, giving you a wider view of the lane next to you. Like if you learned something, and comment your answer. It is time to...

description: Test your knowledge on proper mirror adjustment. Most new drivers set their side mirrors incorrectly, creating massive blind spots. Learn how to position them for maximum visibility and safety on the road. Quick driving tips for beginners.
why_it_will_work: Mini-quizzes perform well by forcing engagement through a question, and it directly addresses a common 'driving tips for beginners' pain point.
